scene_briefs.runbook: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: complete interior illustration for a fictional cybernetic grimoire, portrait 4:5 panel. Input 1 is the book's established figure-art style reference; Input 2 is the earlier page whose abstract idea is being developed, NOT a layout to reproduce. Create one unified scene for 'The extraction of the hand': a deserted medieval-mechanical repairer's workbench; one empty stool; finely drawn strands emerge from a worn hand-shaped wooden repair jig and become the ruled rows of an open procedural ledger. The strands, bench, book and empty seat are a single connected construction in the same spatial setting, no floating character cutouts. The book pages are visibly empty: the rule has survived and the judgment has left. Fine black engraved ink, delicate crosshatching, cellular lace and nested filament structures matching Input 1, restrained slate-blue and dull ochre details, a single thin muted vermilion thread across the desk. Pale warm ivory ground that fades to unmarked paper at all four edges, generous breathing room. Visually legible at 4 inches wide. No text, no letters, no title, no border, no caption, no glyphs, no cipher marks, no watermark. Avoid dense wallpaper, photorealism, gradients, heavy theatrical darkness. This is a complete scene, not a sticker placed over a diagram.
scene_briefs.cord: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: complete interior illustration for a fictional cybernetic grimoire, portrait 4:5 panel. Input 1 is the established figure-art visual language; Input 2 is the earlier page's concept, NOT a page to copy. Create an integrated architectural still-life for 'The office without a seal': the interior of a narrow impossible stone-and-lattice workshop alcove, a delicate ornate mounting bracket at upper center and an empty untouched rectangular recess in its middle. A short cord hangs down from the bracket and ends abruptly in open air ABOVE the recess. A separate lower length rises from a small hand-height pull ring near the bottom and also ends abruptly BELOW the recess. There is a clear spacious GAP between the two ends, no connection, no hidden knot, no thread crossing the empty recess. This absence is the composition's focal point. Surrounding masonry and lace-like carved instrument cabinetry gently curve around the empty place, elegant and a little absurd, no figure. Fine black engraved ink, precise crosshatching, thin cellular filaments, slate-blue and dull ochre insets matching Input 1; one small muted vermilion detail at each broken cord end. Pale warm ivory paper ground fading to clean unmarked paper at all four edges. No text, letters, title, caption, glyphs, seal, symbols, numbers, frame border or watermark. Keep the blank middle truly blank. A single coherent scene with spatial depth, not isolated decals.
